tools.name: studio_status
tools.description: Check that the Koe TTS Studio is reachable, which engines it has, and your free-tier usage. Call this first if a generate call fails — the studio runs on a free host that sleeps after ~15 minutes idle, so the first call can take up to ~60s.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the available voices for an engine. 'edge' = Microsoft neural voices (cloud, many languages); 'piper' = offline on the studio host; 'kokoro' = the local Kokoro sidecar (offline, MP3); 'kitten' = the local Kitten sidecar (offline, WAV, tiny). Voice ids are never shared between engines — always l

tools.name: generate_voiceover
tools.description: Generate a voiceover from text and return it as a short-lived download link (plus inline audio for short clips). Free: the studio applies per-caller hourly/daily word limits. Generated audio is ephemeral — the link works for ~15 minutes, so download the file during the session. Call list_voices firs

tools.name: get_voiceover_status
tools.description: Check the status of one of your TTS jobs by id (useful when generate_voiceover timed out). Jobs expire after about an hour; audio expires sooner.

tools.name: list_recent_voiceovers
tools.description: List your 10 most recent jobs on the studio (newest first). Jobs are tenant-isolated: you only see your own.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show your free-tier usage: requests/words this hour and today, the limits, and when they reset.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "list_voices" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
